terrain._comment: Renderer-facing terrain defaults. tileSize still controls cell width/depth; heightPerFloor controls vertical units per encoded terrain height. Disable floorHeightColors/rampColors once authored per-cell textures should own those colors.

pixelScale._comment: Authoring ruler only. worldUnitsPerPixel <= 0 derives tileSize / mapPixelsPerTile. zoom/worldRender* are legacy compatibility inputs; prefer sceneCamera/worldViewport below.

worldViewport._comment: Shared DS-native scene composition. baseWidth/baseHeight define the low-res pixel density; upscale raises internal 3D resolution for both overworld and TEST ATTEND (1 = DS-like, 2 = 2x).

sceneCamera._comment: 3D scene-camera distance scaling. World billboards project through this camera, so camera moves also scale sprites relative to terrain/models.

pixelCompositor._comment: World-sized pixel-art billboards are projected to the base viewport, quantized to integer pixels, then scaled by worldViewport.upscale. actorDepthBiasPx is a tiny render-only nudge toward the camera to keep paper-thin character quads from intersecting adjacent wall geometry. actorScreenOffsetYPx is a global render-only vertical actor offset; positive values lower actors on screen without changing collision.

presentation._comment: Final backbuffer presentation of the completed internal world target.

occlusion._comment: How far (in tiles) toward the camera a placed model's occlusion anchor is biased when depth-sorting it against the player/follower. Larger = the building starts hiding the character sooner (further forward). Tune so a character entering a doorway is hidden by the building rather than drawing over its roof.

billboard._comment: Actor billboard feet should stay on the simulation XZ position. Keep offsets at 0 unless a purely visual mode is added that cannot affect collision feel.
